qe: Bihar is at present divided into how many divisions and districts?
qh: बिहार वर्तमान में कितने प्रमंडलों तथा जिलों में विभाजित है?
e: Bihar me prashasanik suvidha ke liye rajya ko pramandalon (divisions) tatha jilon (districts) me baanta gaya hai. Vartaman me Bihar me 9 pramandal hain - Patna, Magadh, Saran, Tirhut, Darbhanga, Kosi, Purnea, Bhagalpur tatha Munger - tatha 38 jile hain. Har pramandal ka mukhiya ek 'Pramandal Adhikari' (Commissioner) hota hai, jo apne kshetra ke jilon ke kaam par nazar rakhta hai; har jile ka mukhiya 'Zila Adhikari' (District Magistrate/Collector) hota hai tatha 'Zila Parishad' zila-star par lok-tantra ka adhaar hota hai. Jila aage anumandalon (subdivisions), prakhandon (blocks) tatha panchayats me banta hai. Rajya ka bhautik kshetra 94,163 square kilometre hai, jisme uttar Bihar me ghanatv zyada tatha dakshin-pashchim ke pahadi jilon me kam hota hai. Samastipur aur Bhagalpur jaise jilon ko milakar banaye gaye vikalp galat hain, isliye sahi uttar '9 pramandal tatha 38 jile' hai. Exam point: Bihar me 9 pramandal tatha 38 jile hain; pramandal ka mukhiya Commissioner tatha jila ka mukhiya District Magistrate hota hai; 2000 me Jharkhand alag hone ke baad jo hissa bacha wahi aaj ka Bihar hai.

qe: How many seats does Bihar have in the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha respectively?
qh: बिहार के पास क्रमशः लोकसभा तथा राज्यसभा में कितनी सीटें हैं?
e: Bihar se Lok Sabha me 40 sadasya chune jaate hain; Lok Sabha ke sadasya praja dwara seedhe chunav (direct election) se chune jaate hain. Rajya Sabha me Bihar ka pratinidhitva 16 sadasyaon ka hai; Rajya Sabha ke sadasya vidhan sabha ke chune hue sadasyaon dwara ekal sthantaran (single transferable vote) ki vyavastha se chune jaate hain, isliye unhe 'upper house' ka ghar bhi kaha jaata hai. Rajya me Vidhan Sabha (lower house) ki 243 tatha Vidhan Parishad (upper house) ki 75 sadasyaon ki vyavastha hai - Bihar un thode rajyon me hai jahan do sadan wali vidhayika (bicameral legislature) hai. Lok Sabha ki sambhavit seat sankhya praja-sankhya ke aadhaar par tay hoti hai; Bihar ki jansankhya 10.41 crore (Census 2011) hone ke bawajood 2026 tak seat sankhya 40 hi hai, kyunki parsiman (delimitation) ki prakriya ruki hui hai. Isliye '40 tatha 16' hi sahi jodi hai. Exam point: Bihar - Lok Sabha 40 seat, Rajya Sabha 16 seat, Vidhan Sabha 243 seat tatha Vidhan Parishad 75 seat; Bihar me dvigri (bicameral) vidhayika hai.

qe: Who was the first Chief Minister of Bihar, who took office in 1937 as Premier and became Chief Minister in 1946?
qh: बिहार के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे, जो 1937 में प्रीमियर बने तथा 1946 में मुख्यमंत्री बने?
e: Dr. Sri Krishna Singh, jinhe 'Bihar Kesari' aur pyar se 'Sri Babu' kaha jaata hai, Bihar ke pehle Premier (1937) tatha azaadi ke baad pehle Mukhyamantri (1946 se 1961) the. Unka janm Sheikhpura jile ke Maur gaon me hua tha; 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha ke dauran unhone Begusarai ke Garhpura me kanoon todkar andolan chalaun tatha jail bhi gaye. Mukhyamantri ke roop me unhone apne up-Mukhyamantri Dr. Anugrah Narayan Sinha ke saath milkar Bihar me 1950 ka 'Bihar Bhumi Sudhar Kanoon' (Bihar Land Reforms Act) pass karwaya, jisse zamindari vyavastha khatm hui; is tarah Bihar zamindari khatm karne wala bharat ka pehla rajya bana. Unki smriti me Patna me Sri Krishna Memorial Hall tatha Sri Krishna Vigyan Kendra bane tatha 21 October ko unki jayanti manayi jaati hai. Anugrah Narayan Sinha pehle up-Mukhyamantri the, Mahamaya Prasad Sinha 1967 me pehle gair-Congress CM bane tatha Karpoori Thakur 1970-71 me CM bane. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle Mukhyamantri = Dr. Sri Krishna Singh ('Bihar Kesari'); Bihar Land Reforms Act 1950 se zamindari khatm - Bihar pehla rajya; pehle up-Mukhyamantri = Anugrah Narayan Sinha ('Bihar Vibhuti').

qe: Who was the first Deputy Chief Minister and Finance Minister of Bihar, known as 'Bihar Vibhuti'?
qh: बिहार के प्रथम उप-मुख्यमंत्री तथा वित्त मंत्री कौन थे, जिन्हें 'बिहार विभूति' कहा जाता है?
e: Dr. Anugrah Narayan Sinha (janm Poiyawan, Aurangabad) ko 'Bihar Vibhuti' kaha jaata hai; woh 1946 se 1957 tak Bihar ke pehle up-Mukhyamantri tatha pehle Vitt Mantri (Finance Minister) rahe. Unhone Champaran Satyagraha (1917) me Gandhi ji ke saath milkar kisanon ke bayaan darj kiye tatha 1930 ke namak satyagrah tatha 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan me bhi bhaag liya. Mukhyamantri Sri Krishna Singh ke saath unhone Bihar ki aarthik neeti ka blueprint banaya - Kosi tatha Gandak pariyojnaon ka samarthan, krishi tatha sinchai par zor, tatha rajya ke udyogon ko protsahit karna. Unki smriti me Patna me A.N. Sinha Institute of Social Studies tatha A.N. College banaye gaye. Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha samvidhan sabha ke asthayi adhyaksh the, Jagjivan Ram kendriya mantri tatha up-Pradhanmantri rahe, tatha Basawon Singh krantikari tatha Congress Socialist Party ke sahyogi the. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle up-Mukhyamantri tatha pehle Vitt Mantri = Dr. Anugrah Narayan Sinha ('Bihar Vibhuti', 1946-1957); ANSISS Patna unke naam par.

qe: Who was the first non-Congress Chief Minister of Bihar, who headed the Samyukta Vidhayak Dal government in 1967?
qh: बिहार के प्रथम गैर-कांग्रेसी मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे, जिन्होंने 1967 में संयुक्त विधायक दल की सरकार बनाई?
e: 1967 ke aam chunav ke baad Bihar me Congress ka ekal shasan khatm ho gaya tatha 'Samyukta Vidhayak Dal' (SVD) naam se gathbandhan ki sarkar bani; iske Mukhyamantri Mahamaya Prasad Sinha 5 March 1967 ko bane, isliye woh Bihar ke pehle gair-Congressi Mukhyamantri kehlate hain. Us chunav me unhone Patna West se Congress ke Mukhyamantri K.B. Sahay ko hara kar charchit jite haasil ki thi. SVD sarkar me Karpoori Thakur up-Mukhyamantri bane the tatha doosre dalon ke neta bhi shaamil the; Bharat me gathbandhan ki rajneeti (coalition politics) ke puraane udaharan me Bihar ki SVD sarkar ek mahatvapurn sthal rakhti hai. Is sarkar ne shaikshik tatha samajik sudhar ke kuch kadam uthe, lekin andaruni matbhedon ke kaaran yah lambi nahi chali. Bindeshwari Dubey baad me Congress ke Mukhyamantri bane tatha Satyendra Narayan Sinha bhi Bihar ke Mukhyamantri rahe, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle gair-Congressi Mukhyamantri = Mahamaya Prasad Sinha (SVD sarkar, 5 March 1967), jisme Karpoori Thakur up-Mukhyamantri the.

qe: The Patna High Court, which is the highest court of Bihar, was established in which year?
qh: बिहार का सर्वोच्च न्यायालय पटना उच्च न्यायालय किस वर्ष स्थापित हुआ?
e: Patna High Court ki sthapna 1 March 1916 ko hui; yah Bihar tatha Orissa pradesh ka uchch nyayalaya tha tatha iska pura naya bhavan Patna me Ganga kinare banaa. 1936 me Orissa alag pradesh bana, to Patna High Court sirf Bihar ke liye rah gaya; 15 November 2000 ko Jharkhand alag rajya bana, tab Ranchi me alag uchch nyayalaya banaya gaya. Uchch nyayalaya (High Court) kisi rajya ke andar sabse bada nyayalaya hota hai - yah mool adhikar (fundamental rights) ki raksha karta hai, nichli adalaton ke faislon par appeal sunta hai tatha sarkar ke kanoonon ki vaidhata ki jaanch kar sakta hai; iska mukhiya 'Chief Justice' hota hai. Isliye 1912 (Bihar alag prant banne ka varsh), 1936 (Orissa alag hone ka varsh) tatha 1950 (samvidhan lagu hone ka varsh) me bhi koi bhi sthapna nahi hui, isliye 1916 hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Patna High Court = 1916 me sthapit; 1936 me Orissa tatha 2000 me Jharkhand alag hone par kshetra-adhikar badla; aaj Bihar ka kendriya nyayalaya Patna me hai.

qe: Who was the first Governor of Bihar after India became a Republic in 1950?
qh: 1950 में भारत गणराज्य बनने के बाद बिहार के प्रथम राज्यपाल कौन थे?
e: Bharat ke ganrajya banane ke baad (26 January 1950) Bihar ke pehle Rajyapal (Governor) Jairamdas Daulatram bane; unhone 1948 se 1956 tak is pad ko snbhaala. Rajyapal rajya me sanvidhanik mukhiya hote hain - woh Mukhyamantri tatha mantriparishad ki salah par kaam karte hain, vidhan sabha ke paas hue vidhayak-billon ko apni svikriti dete hain tatha rajya ke vishwavidyalaya ke Kulguru (Chancellor) bhi hote hain. Azaadi se pehle Bihar me Governor ka pad 1936 se tha, par 1950 me samvidhan lagu hone ke baad pehle sanvidhanik Rajyapal ke roop me Daulatram ji aaye. Dr. Rajendra Prasad bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati bane, Dr. Sri Krishna Singh Bihar ke Mukhyamantri the tatha Sachchidananda Sinha samvidhan sabha ke asthayi adhyaksh the - isliye woh teeno sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Bihar ke pehle Rajyapal (1950 ke baad) = Jairamdas Daulatram; Rajyapal Mukhyamantri ki salah par kaam karte hain tatha vishwavidyalaya ke Chancellor hote hain.

qe: Bihar and Orissa were formed into a separate province in 1912; in which year did Orissa become a separate province, leaving Bihar as a governor's province?
qh: 1912 में बिहार और उड़ीसा को मिलाकर पृथक प्रांत बनाया गया था; किस वर्ष उड़ीसा अलग प्रांत बना, जिससे बिहार गवर्नर के प्रांत के रूप में रह गया?
e: 22 March 1912 ko Bengal se alag kar 'Bihar and Orissa' naam ka naya prant banaya gaya tha; isi ghatna ki smriti me aaj 22 March ko Bihar Diwas manaya jaata hai. Kuch samay baad Orissa ke logon ki apni alag pehchan ki maang tez hui tatha Government of India Act 1935 ke aadhaar par 1 April 1936 ko Orissa alag prant bana; uske baad Bihar gavarnar ke apne prant ke roop me rah gaya. Isi badlav ka asar Patna High Court par bhi pada, jo 1916 me Bihar-Orissa ke liye bana tha aur 1936 ke baad sirf Bihar ke kshetra-adhikar me aa gaya. Iske baad 15 November 2000 ko ek aur bade vibhajan me Bihar se alag kar Jharkhand rajya banaya gaya, jisse aaj ka Bihar 38 jilon wala rajya ban gaya. Isliye is prashn ka sahi varsh 1936 hai; 1912 prant banne ka, 1950 samvidhan lagu hone ka tatha 1919 Montagu-Chelmsford sudhar ka varsh tha. Exam point: 1912 = Bihar and Orissa prant ka gathan (Bihar Diwas ki tariq), 1 April 1936 = Orissa alag prant (Bihar gavarnar ka prant), 15 November 2000 = Bihar se Jharkhand alag.

qe: Dr. Rajendra Prasad, who was President of the Constituent Assembly and the first President of India, belonged to which district of Bihar?
qh: संविधान सभा के अध्यक्ष तथा भारत के प्रथम राष्ट्रपति डॉ. राजेन्द्र प्रसाद बिहार के किस जिले से थे?
e: Dr. Rajendra Prasad ka janm Siwan jile ke Ziradei gaon me hua tha; unhe 'Deshratna' tatha 'Ajatshatru' kaha jaata hai (Ajatshatru ka arth hai jiska koi shatru na ho). Woh 11 December 1946 ko Samvidhan Sabha ke sthayi adhyaksh chune gaye tatha samvidhan banne ke baad 1950 se 1962 tak bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati rahe; isi karan unhe 1962 me Bharat Ratna mila. 1917 ke Champaran Satyagraha me woh Gandhi ji ke saath kisanon ke bayaan lene tatha unki samasyayein jaanne me shaamil the; 1934 ke Bihar bhukamp ke samay unhone rahat-karya ka netritva kiya. Unki smriti me Patna ke Bans Ghat par Rajendra Samadhi Sthal tatha Rajendra Smriti Sangrahalaya (Sadaqat Ashram) sthit hai. Saran, Gopalganj tatha Bhojpur anya jile hain jahan anya swatantrata-senaniyon ka janm hua, isliye Rajendra Babu ke liye 'Siwan' hi sahi hai. Exam point: Dr. Rajendra Prasad = janm Ziradei, Siwan; 'Deshratna' tatha 'Ajatshatru'; Samvidhan Sabha ke sthayi adhyaksh (11 December 1946) tatha bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati (1950-1962), Bharat Ratna 1962.

qe: On 1 November 1956, Bihar transferred about 3,166 square miles of its area to which neighbouring state?
qh: 1 नवंबर 1956 को बिहार ने अपना लगभग 3,166 वर्ग मील क्षेत्र किस पड़ोसी राज्य को हस्तांतरित किया?
e: 1 November 1956 ko rajya punargathan ke samay Bihar ka ek bada kshetra padosi West Bengal ko diya gaya; kul milakar 3,166 square mile kshetra gaya, jisme Purnea jile ke 759 square mile tatha Manbhum jile ke 2,407 square mile shaamil the. Is kshetra me lagbhag 14,46,385 log rahte the tatha isme Manbhum jile ke Purulia ilaake ke kai thane (Jaipur, Hura, Barabazar, Balarampur aadi) tatha Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka ek hissa shaamil tha. Seema tatha zameen ki yah katti-chaanti ek Revenue Officer ki nigrani me hui, jiski niyukti Kendriya Sarkar ne ki tatha nirdharan ka aadhaar Dalkola-Kishanganj-Chopra-Siliguri highway tatha Dalkola-Raiganj marg ke aas-paas ki seema thi. Isliye sahi uttar West Bengal hai. Exam point: 1 November 1956 ko Bihar ne West Bengal ko lagbhag 3,166 square mile kshetra diya - Purnea 759 tatha Manbhum 2,407 square mile; is kshetra me Purulia ilaaka mukhya tha tatha seema nirdharan Kendriya Sarkar dwara niyukt Revenue Officer ne kiya.

qe: Which district's subdivision, Purulia, was transferred from Bihar to West Bengal in 1956?
qh: 1956 में बिहार से पश्चिम बंगाल को हस्तांतरित कौन-सा उपमंडल (पुरुलिया) था?
e: Purulia Manbhum jile ka ek upmandal tha tatha 1956 me yah poora ilaaka Bihar se nikal kar West Bengal me chala gaya; isi ke saath Manbhum ke kai thane bhi gaye, jaise Jaipur, Hura, Barabazar, Balarampur, Puncha, Santuri aadi. Manbhum jila apne aap me ek bahut purana prashasanik kshetra tha, jiska bada hissa aaj bhi West Bengal tatha Jharkhand ke beech banta hua dikhta hai; iska naam 'Manbhum' bhumij-kshetra se juda hua maana jaata hai, jahan bhumij tatha anya aadivasi samuday rahte the. Isi vajah se 1956 ke baad Manbhum jile ka naam-badal hua tatha uska ek hissa Purulia jila ke roop me West Bengal me tatha doosra hissa Dhanbad aadi ke roop me aage chala. Purnea ka ek chhota hissa (759 square mile) bhi West Bengal ko gaya, lekin poora upmandal ke taur par Purulia ka hantaran Manbhum se hi juda hai - isliye sahi uttar Manbhum hai. Exam point: Purulia upmandal = Manbhum jile se, 1956 me West Bengal ko; Purnea ka 759 square mile hissa bhi 1956 me gaya; Manbhum kshetra aadivasi-bahul tha.

qe: The area transferred from Bihar to West Bengal in 1956 had a population of about how many persons?
qh: 1956 में बिहार से पश्चिम बंगाल को गए क्षेत्र की जनसंख्या लगभग कितनी थी?
e: 1956 me Bihar se West Bengal ko gaye kshetra ki jansankhya lagbhag 14,46,385 (yaani takriban 14.5 lakh) thi; is kshetra me Manbhum jile ke Purulia ilaake ke kai thane tatha Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka ek hissa shaamil the. Jansankhya ke aise aankdon ka mahatva isliye hota hai kyunki seema badalne se dono rajyon ke ghanatv, jansankhya-anupat tatha vidhan-sabha seaton ke aankdon par bhi asar padta hai; yahi karan hai ki 1956 ke baad Bihar tatha West Bengal dono ki jansankhya-ginti badli. Aaj Bihar ka kshetrafal lagbhag 94,163 square kilometre hai tatha yah 1956 me hui katti ke baad ka aankda hai; isliye 1956 ki seema-katti ko samajhna rajya ke bhoogol ke liye zaroori hai. Chand lakh tatha crore ke antar par dhyan dena zaroori hai, isliye sahi uttar 'lagbhag 14.5 lakh' hai. Exam point: 1956 me Bihar se West Bengal ko gaye kshetra ki jansankhya lagbhag 14.5 lakh (14,46,385); kshetrafal 3,166 square mile; aaj Bihar ka kshetrafal lagbhag 94,163 square kilometre hai.

qe: What was the basis used in 1956 to demarcate the Bihar-West Bengal boundary in the transferred area?
qh: 1956 में हस्तांतरित क्षेत्र में बिहार-पश्चिम बंगाल सीमा का निर्धारण किस आधार पर किया गया?
oe: The course of the Ganga river
Distance from highways such as the Dalkola-Kishanganj-Siliguri road
The line of the railway track
e: 1956 me seema ka nirdharan karne ke liye Kendriya Sarkar ne ek Revenue Officer niyukta kiya; usne seema nirdharan ka aadhaar sadak (highway) rakha - jaise Dalkola, Kishanganj tatha Chopra ko Siliguri se jodne wali highway ke lagbhag 200 gaj pashchim ki line tatha Dalkola-Karandighi-Raiganj marg ke 200 gaj dakshin ya dakshin-pashchim ki line. Isi aadhaar par Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka ek hissa tatha Gopalpur thana ka kuch hissa West Bengal ko diya gaya, jabki baaki Bihar ke paas raha. Sadak-par adhaarit seema ka matlab yah tha ki gaon-sadak tatha bazaar ke raste aas-paas ke ilaake ke saath jude rahein tatha logon ka aana-jaana aasan bana rahe. Ganga ki dhara, rail-line ya van-khand is seema nirdharan ke aadhaar nahi the - isliye sahi uttar sadak-highway se doori hai. Exam point: 1956 ki Bihar-West Bengal seema = highway (Dalkola-Kishanganj-Siliguri tatha Dalkola-Raiganj marg) se lagbhag 200 gaj doori ke aadhaar par; nirdharan Kendriya Sarkar dwara niyukt Revenue Officer ne kiya.

qe: Which subdivision of Purnea district lost a portion of its area to West Bengal in the 1956 boundary settlement?
qh: 1956 की सीमा-व्यवस्था में पूर्णिया जिले के किस उपमंडल का एक हिस्सा पश्चिम बंगाल को गया?
e: 1956 ki seema-katti me Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal ka woh hissa West Bengal ko diya gaya jo nirdharit seema-rekha ke purab tatha Gopalpur thana se sambandhit tha; yani pura Kishanganj nahi gaya, balki highway-based line ke purab ka ilaaka gaya. Purnea jile ne kul milakar 759 square mile kshetra khoya, jabki baaki hissa Bihar ke paas raha tatha aage chal kar yah kshetra Araria, Katihar tatha Kishanganj jilon me bant gaya. Aise vibhajan se samajh aata hai ki 1947 ke baad bhi seema badalti rahi tatha rajya punargathan ke samay kshetrafal tatha jansankhya dono ke aankde badle. Araria, Katihar tatha Forbesganj jaise upmandal ya kshetra alag hain tatha unka koi hissa 1956 me West Bengal ko nahi gaya - isliye sahi uttar Kishanganj hai. Exam point: 1956 me Purnea jile ke Kishanganj upmandal tatha Gopalpur thana ka kuch hissa West Bengal ko gaya; Purnea ne kul 759 square mile khoya; aage yahi kshetra Araria, Katihar tatha Kishanganj jilon me banta.

qe: The municipality of Dinapore Nizamat was constituted in which year, with a board of twenty commissioners of whom sixteen were elected?
qh: दीनापुर निजामत की नगरपालिका किस वर्ष बनी, जिसके बोर्ड में बीस कमिश्नर थे जिनमें सोलह निर्वाचित थे?
e: Jile me paanch nagarpalikayein thin - Patna, Barh, Bihar, Dinapore tatha Khagaul - jinke alawa nayi rajdhani ke kshetra ke liye Patna Administration Committee bhi kaam karti thi. Inme se Dinapore Nizamat ki nagarpalika 1869 me banayi gayi thi; iske municipal board me bees commissioners the, jinme se solah nirvachit yaani elected the tatha shesh sadasya anya madhyam se aate the. Dinapore Nizamat ke municipal kshetra ka area paanch square mile tha tatha is kshetra me 4,878 ratepayers the; ratepayer aise vyakti ko kehte the, jo nagarpalika ko rates tatha taxes deta tha tatha is karan chunav me vote ka haq rakhta tha. Dinapur ek sainik chhawni ka nagar hone ke saath-saath ek badi mandi tatha vyaparik kendra bhi tha, isliye yahan nagarpalika ki aay rates tatha taxes, pashu-bandhon tatha Government aur Local Funds ki grants se aati thi. Yah nagarpalika safai, roshni, aspatal tatha sadkon jaise kaamon ke liye zimmedar thi; 1921-22 me iska safai par kharch sabse zyada, Rs 14,363 tha. Exam point: Dinapore Nizamat ki nagarpalika 1869 me bani thi tatha uske board me bees commissioners the jinme solah nirvachit the; kshetra paanch square mile ka tha tatha usme 4,878 ratepayers the.

qe: The town of Khagaul was constituted a municipality on which date?
qh: खगौल नगर को किस तारीख़ को नगरपालिका बनाया गया?
e: Jile me Patna ke alawa kuch anya nagar bhi nagarpalika ke roop me sanchalit the; Khagaul nagar ko 1 July 1907 ko nagarpalika banaya gaya. Wahan us samay 1,338 ratepayers the tatha municipal board me kul gyarah commissioners the, jinme se nau nirvachit yaani elected the tatha shesh sadasya anya madhyam se aate the. Khagaul ek mahatvapurna nagar tha, kyunki yahan se hokar Patna-Gaya Canal tatha railway line jaati thi tatha aspaas krishi ka vyapar hota tha. Nagarpalika ke saalana aay-kharch me rates tatha taxes, cattle-pounds tatha Government se milne wali grants shamil thi tatha kharch me administration, lighting, conservancy, roads tatha education ke shirsh the. Exam point: Khagaul nagar 1 July 1907 ko nagarpalika bana; wahan 1,338 ratepayers the tatha 11 commissioners ka board tha, jinme 9 nirvachit the.

qe: How many of the eleven commissioners of the Khagaul municipal board were elected?
qh: खगौल नगरपालिका बोर्ड के ग्यारह आयुक्तों में कितने निर्वाचित थे?
e: Khagaul nagarpalika ke board me kul gyarah commissioners the, jinme se nau nirvachit yaani elected the. Nagarpalika ke kaam me administration yaani prabandh, lighting yaani roshni, conservancy yaani safai, roads yaani sadke tatha education yaani shiksha jaise shirsh shamil the. 1921-22 ke aas-paas Khagaul nagarpalika ka kul kharch lagbhag 14,775 rupees tha, jisme safai par sabse adhik Rs 6,208 lagaye gaye; prabandh par Rs 3,092 tatha roshni par Rs 2,599 kharch hue, jabki sadkon par keval Rs 448. Is sankshipt vishleshan se pata chalta hai ki chhote nagar-palikaon me bhi safai tatha roshni jaise mool kaamon par sabse adhik dhan kharch hota tha. Exam point: Khagaul nagarpalika ke 11 commissioners me se 9 nirvachit the; nagarpalika ke kharch me safai (Rs 6,208) tatha prabandh (Rs 3,092) mukhya shirsh the.

qe: The Patna Administration Committee, which administered the area within the new capital in respect of lighting, drainage, conservancy and the municipal market, was nominated under which Act?
qh: नई राजधानी के भीतर के क्षेत्र का, रोशनी, नाली-निकासी, सफ़ाई तथा नगरीय बाज़ार के मामले में प्रशासन करने वाली पटना प्रशासन समिति किस अधिनियम के अंतर्गत नामित की गई?
e: Patna me do alag-alag sansthayein nagar-sevaon ka kaam dekhti thi - purane nagar ke liye municipal board tatha nayi rajdhani ke kshetra ke liye Patna Administration Committee. Yah Committee Act I of 1915 ke antargat nominated yaani namit ki gayi thi tatha usme nau sadasya the. Iske kaam me roshni, drainage yaani nali-nikasi, conservancy yaani safai, municipal market yaani nagariya bazar tatha building regulations yaani bhavan-nirman ke niyamon ka palan karana shamil tha; is kshetra me 720 ratepayers the. Chunki yah kshetra abhi poora ban raha tha, isliye iski aay ka mukhya sadhan Government ki grant thi; 1921-22 me rates tatha taxes se aay Rs 68,231 hui thi tatha Committee ne safai par Rs 31,928 kharch kiye. Exam point: Patna Administration Committee Act I of 1915 ke antargat namit hui thi tatha isme nau sadasya the; yah roshni, drainage, safai, nagariya bazar tatha bhavan-nirman niyamon ka prabandh dekhti thi tatha iske 720 ratepayers the.

qe: What has hitherto been the main source of income of the Patna Administration Committee, dealing as it does with a city still in course of completion?
qh: पटना प्रशासन समिति की आय का मुख्य स्रोत अब तक क्या रहा है, जो एक ऐसे नगर का काम देख रही है जो अभी पूरा बन रहा है?
oh: सरकार से मिलने वाली अनुदान राशि
e: Patna Administration Committee ka kshetra nayi rajdhani ka woh bhaag tha jo abhi poora ban raha tha; isliye wahan aabadi tatha sampatti seemit thi tatha rates-taxes se aay kam hoti thi. Isi karan is Committee ki aay ka mukhya sadhan ab tak Government se milne wali grant rahi. 1921-22 me rates tatha taxes se aay Rs 68,231 hui thi tatha Committee ne administration par Rs 6,772, lighting par Rs 5,810, conservancy par Rs 31,928 tatha anya safai-sambandhi kaamon par Rs 5,400 kharch kiye. Aise aankde batate hain ki naye shahari kshetra me shuru me sadke, naliyan tatha safai jaise mool kaam sarkari dhan se hi pure kiye jaate the. Exam point: nayi rajdhani ke bante kshetra me rates-taxes se aay kam thi, isliye Patna Administration Committee ki aay ka mukhya sadhan Government ki grant rahi; safai par sabse adhik Rs 31,928 kharch hua.

qe: In 1921-22 the Patna City municipality, the most important municipality of the district, spent the largest amount on which single head?
qh: जिले की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण नगरपालिका पटना सिटी ने 1921-22 में सबसे अधिक खर्च किस एक शीर्ष पर किया?
e: Jile ki sabse mahatvapurna nagarpalika Patna City ki thi, jo 1864 me bani thi. Iske municipal kshetra me Patna City proper tatha uske upnagar bhi shamil the, jo Bankipore tak phaile hue the; yahan 27,600 ratepayers the tatha municipal board me chalis sadasya the, jinme se battis nirvachit yaani elected the. Is nagarpalika ki aay ka mukhya sadhan ghar-milkiyat ke saalana mulya par lagne wala kar tha, jiske saath ek latrine fee bhi li jaati thi; nagar ke pashchim bhaag me paani ki achhi supply bhi kar di gayi thi. 1921-22 me nagarpalika ke kharch ke mukhya shirsh the - conservancy yaani safai, lighting yaani roshni, water-supply, drainage, sadke, aspatal tatha shiksha. Inme safai par sabse zyada, Rs 1,35,442 kharch hue, jo is baat ka sabut hai ki ghani aabadi wale purane nagar me safai sabse bada tatha sabse mushkil kaam tha. Exam point: Patna City nagarpalika 1864 me bani thi tatha 1921-22 me uska sabse bada kharch safai par Rs 1,35,442 hua; kshetra me 27,600 ratepayers the tatha board ke 40 sadasyaon me se 32 nirvachit the.

qe: The Secretariat building of the new capital at Patna is the largest building there, 716 feet long and 46 feet in breadth; what is the height of its most prominent feature, the clock tower?
qh: पटना की नई राजधानी की सचिवालय इमारत वहाँ की सबसे बड़ी इमारत है, जो 716 फुट लंबी तथा 46 फुट चौड़ी है; इसकी सबसे प्रमुख विशेषता घड़ी-मीनार की ऊँचाई कितनी है?
e: Nayi rajdhani ka kshetra purani Patna-Gaya road ke pashchim me teen varg meel se thoda kam hai; ise aadhunik tarike se basaya gaya tatha King George Avenue iska mukhya marg bana. New capital me Secretariat sabse badi imarat hai - 716 foot lambi tatha 46 foot chauri. Iski ground floor par 105 kamre tatha pehli manzil par 93 kamre hain, jinme tees daftar tatha paanch sau clerk baithte hain. Is imarat ki sabse aakarshak visheshata iski clock tower yaani ghadi-minar hai, jo ek sau chhihattar foot unchi hai tatha pacchas foot chaukor aadhaar par khadi hai. Minar ke aadhaar ki chinalai ki motai teen foot chaar inch hai, jo upar ja kar chaudah foot tak patli hoti jaati hai. Minar ke upar ek balcony hai, jahan se poore capital kshetra tatha aas-paas ke ilake ka drishya dekha ja sakta hai. Exam point: New capital ki sabse badi imarat Secretariat 716 foot lambi tatha 46 foot chauri hai, jiski ground floor par 105 tatha pehli manzil par 93 kamre hain; iski clock tower 176 foot unchi hai.

qe: The Council Chamber of the Patna capital, measuring sixty feet by fifty and extending through both floors, was completed in 1920 and was designed by which architect?
qh: पटना राजधानी का काउंसिल चैंबर, जो साठ फुट गुणा पचास फुट है तथा दोनों मंजिलों तक फैला है, 1920 में पूरा हुआ था तथा इसे किस स्थपति ने डिज़ाइन किया था?
e: Patna ki nayi rajdhani me Secretariat ke purb me Council Chamber sthit hai, jise 1920 me poora kiya gaya. Ise Mr. A. M. Millwood ne design kiya tha, aur uski shaili free Renaissance thi, jo peeche khadi Secretariat imarat ke saath mel khaati hai; baaki nayi rajdhani ki tarah yah bhi eenton tatha plaster me bani hai. Council Chamber sabha-ghar ka woh hissa hota hai, jahan sadasya baith kar charcha tatha nirnay karte hain. Iska aakaar saath foot into pacchas foot hai tatha yah imarat ki dono manzilon tak faila hua hai; upar wali manzil ke level par visitors tatha press ke pratinidhiyon ke liye gallery banai gayi hai. Isi kothi me King-Emperor ka portrait Snowman dwara banaya gaya tatha members ke kamron me Bihar tatha Orissa ke pehle Lieutenant-Governors Sir Charles Bayley tatha Sir Edward Gait ke portraits H. A. Olivier dwara banaye gaye. Exam point: Patna capital ka Council Chamber 1920 me poora hua tatha ise Mr. A. M. Millwood ne free Renaissance shaili me design kiya; yah saath foot into pacchas foot ka hai tatha dono manzilon tak faila hai.

qe: King George's Avenue, the central avenue of the new capital at Patna running between the Secretariat and Government House, is nearly a mile long and how wide?
qh: पटना की नई राजधानी का केंद्रीय मार्ग किंग जॉर्ज एवेन्यू, जो सचिवालय तथा गवर्नमेंट हाउस के बीच पूर्व-पश्चिम फैला है, लगभग एक मील लंबा तथा कितना चौड़ा है?
e: Nayi rajdhani ki layout ki mukhya visheshata iska central avenue tatha King George Avenue hai, jo Secretariat tatha Government House ke beech purb se pashchim ki or jaata hai. Yah lagbhag ek meel lamba tatha do sau foot chaura ek bahut hi sunder marg hai. Capital ko design karne walon ko aadhunik aawaagaman yaani transport ki zaruraton ka bhi khayal raha, isliye yahan purane shahron wali sankri galiyon tatha achanak mudne wale raste nahi milte. Yahan mukhya raste ek sau pacchas foot chaura hain tatha unke dono or ped lagaye gaye hain, jabki service roads saath foot chaura hain. Raston ke intersections par islands banaye gaye, jinki baad me fencing ki gayi tatha unpar jhaadiyan lagai gayin. Is tarah yah kshetra vasstu yaani architect Mr. J. F. Munnings tatha unke sahayakon ki achhi planing ka udaharan hai. Exam point: King George Avenue lagbhag ek meel lamba tatha do sau foot chaura hai tatha yah Secretariat tatha Government House ke beech purb-pashchim jaata hai; nayi rajdhani ke mukhya raste ek sau pacchas foot tatha service roads saath foot chaure hain.

qe: Land acquired at Muharrampur, Kadam Kuan and Pirthipur for housing people displaced by slum clearance in Bankipore was made over in 1916 to the Patna City Municipal Commissioners as trustees, along with a grant of how much?
qh: बांकीपुर में गंदी बस्तियों को हटाने से विस्थापित लोगों के आवास के लिए मुहर्रमपुर, कदम कुआँ तथा पृथ्वीपुर में अर्जित भूमि 1916 में पटना सिटी नगर आयुक्तों को न्यासी रूप में सौंपी गई, साथ में कितना अनुदान दिया गया?
e: Patna shahar ke bhare-bhare ilake khole jaane tatha raston ko chaura karne ki samasya Local Government ke dhyan me aayi, jab prant banaya gaya. Ek survey ke baad Bankipore ki kuch sabse gandi bastiyon yaani insanitary bastis ko todne ke liye chuna gaya. Jin logon ke ghar is kaam se chhinn-jod ho rahe the, unke aavas ke liye Muharrampur, Kadam Kuan tatha Pirthipur me zameen kharidi gayi. Yah kshetra 1916 me Patna City Municipal Commissioners ko nyasi yaani trustee ke roop me saunp diya gaya, saath me pacchas hazaar rupaye ka anudaan diya gaya, jisme baad me kaafi aur dhan joda gaya. Is trust ka kaam zyada safal nahi hua, kyunki trustee sabha bahut badi thi tatha log Government se baadhi niyantran yaani protective works ka intezaar kar rahe the; 1923 ke madhya tak zameen par sthayi settlement ka nirnay hua. Exam point: 1916 me Muharrampur, Kadam Kuan tatha Pirthipur ki arjit zameen Patna City Municipal Commissioners ko trustee roop me di gayi tatha saath me pacchas hazaar rupaye ka anudaan mila; yah vyavastha Patna Improvement Trust ke roop me chali.

qe: For administrative purposes the Patna district was divided into which subdivisions, with Bankipore as the headquarters of its principal officers?
qh: प्रशासनिक कार्यों के लिए पटना जिला किन अनुमंडलों में बाँटा गया था, जहाँ बांकीपुर मुख्य अधिकारियों का मुख्यालय था?
oe: Bankipore, Barh, Bihar, Dinapore and Mokameh
Patna City, Barh, Bihar, Gaya and Dinapore
Bankipore, Patna City, Barh, Bihar and Mokameh
Bankipore, Patna City, Barh, Bihar and Dinapore
oh: बांकीपुर, बाढ़, बिहार, दीनापुर तथा मोकामा
पटना सिटी, बाढ़, बिहार, गया तथा दीनापुर
बांकीपुर, पटना सिटी, बाढ़, बिहार तथा मोकामा
बांकीपुर, पटना सिटी, बाढ़, बिहार तथा दीनापुर
e: Patna jile ka mukhya karyalay Bankipore me tha, jo Patna division ke Commissioner tatha jile ke Magistrate tatha Collector, dono ka headquarters tha. Prashasanik suvidha ke liye jila paanch anumandalo me banta hua tha - Bankipore, Patna City, Barh, Bihar tatha Dinapore. Magistrate-Collector yaani woh adhikari, jo jile me rajasva vasooli tatha shaanti-vyavastha, dono ka pramukh hota tha, uski madad ke liye ek additional District Magistrate bhi tha, jo shahar me tainat rehta tha. Har anumandal ka apna subdivisional magistrate hota tha, tatha Dinapore Cantonment alag se ek military cantonment magistrate ke charge me rehta tha. Aise varnan se saaf pata chalta hai ki jile ka prashasan chhote-chhote kshetron me baant kar chalaya jata tha. Exam point: Patna jile me paanch anumandal the - Bankipore, Patna City, Barh, Bihar tatha Dinapore; Bankipore division tatha jile ke mukhya adhikariyon ka headquarters tha.

qe: The additional District Magistrate, who was ordinarily stationed in the city of Patna, held charge of which subdivision?
qh: पटना शहर में सामान्यतः तैनात रहने वाले अपर जिला मजिस्ट्रेट के पास किस अनुमंडल का प्रभार रहता था?
e: Jile ke prashasanik dhanche me Magistrate-Collector ki madad ke liye ek additional District Magistrate tainat tha, jo sadharan taur par Patna shahar me rehta tha tatha Patna City anumandal ka charge dekhta tha. Patna City kshetra purane shahar ka vyaparik tatha ghani aabaadi wala bhag tha, isliye wahan alag prabhutva-sambandhi dhyan dene ke liye yah vyavastha ki gayi thi. Mukhya karyalay ki sthaa me saat deputy collectors tatha teen sub-deputy collectors ka staff hota tha, aur pratyek subdivisional magistrate ki madad ke liye ek deputy ya sub-deputy magistrate tainat hota tha. Isi tarah shahar tatha gaon, dono ke liye alag-alag star par adhikari banaye gaye the. Exam point: Patna shahar me tainat additional District Magistrate ke paas Patna City anumandal ka charge rehta tha, jabki mukhya karyalay me saat deputy collectors tatha teen sub-deputy collectors ka staff tha.

qe: For police purposes the district was divided into thirty-two thanas, but all the old thanas had been subdivided except which two?
qh: पुलिस के लिए जिला बत्तीस थानों में बाँटा गया था, लेकिन पुराने सभी थाने तोड़े जा चुके थे, सिवाय किन दो के?
e: Patna jile me police-prabandh ke liye bataais thane yaani police circles tatha ikattis outposts bane hue the. Survey tatha settlement ke kaam ke samay rajasva-vibhajan ke liye purane parganon ki jagah us samay ke thanon ko hi apna liya gaya, lekin samay ke saath jin sthalon par pehle sirf outpost the, wahan alag police-station ban gaye. Isliye purane sabhi thane baad me tode yaani bat gaye, sirf do apwaad the - Fatuha tatha Islampur. Police ka samanya niyantran Superintendent of Police ke haath me tha, jiske niche assistant superintendent, do deputy superintendents, barah inspectors, tirahattar sub-inspectors, ek sau pachas head-constables tatha ek hazaar teen sau atthaanve constables the. Exam point: Police ke liye jila bataais thanon me banta tha tatha purane sabhi thane baad me tode gaye, sirf Fatuha tatha Islampur thane hi nahi tode gaye.

qe: Besides the regular police, the rural force for the watch and ward of villages consisted of how many dafadars and how many chaukidars?
qh: नियमित पुलिस के अलावा, गाँवों की चौकसी तथा रखवाली करने वाले ग्रामीण बल में कितने दफादार तथा कितने चौकीदार थे?
e: Jile me niyamit police ke alawa gaon ki suraksha ke liye ek alag gramin bal bhi tha, jisme do sau sattasi dafadar tatha teen hazaar chaukidar the. Dafadar yaani chaukidaron ka mukhiya ya jamadar, jo chhote-chhote gaon ke chaukidaron ke kaam ki nigrani karta tha; chaukidar raat ke waqt gaon me paharai tatha aavagaman ki jaankari rakhta tha. Gramin thane ke adhikari isi bal ke sahare dur-daraz ke gaon tak pahunchte the, kyunki bade thanon ka apna staff har gaon me tainat nahi hota tha. Isi tarah gaon ki suraksha ka bhaar purane samudayik tatha rajkiya prabandh se hokar police-tantra ke haath me aa gaya tha. Exam point: Jile me gaon ki chaukas-tatha-rakhwali wala gramin bal do sau sattasi dafadaron tatha teen hazaar chaukidaron ka tha.

qe: The re-constituted District Board of the district consisted of how many members in all, and how many of them were elected?
qh: जिले के पुनर्गठित जिला परिषद में कुल कितने सदस्य थे तथा उनमें से कितने निर्वाचित थे?
oe: Twenty-four members, of whom twelve were elected
Forty members, of whom eighteen were elected
Thirty members, of whom twenty were elected
Forty members, of whom thirty were elected
e: Nagarpalika kshetron ke bahar jile ke sthaniya kaam District Board dekhti thi, jiska adhikar poore jile par tha, tatha har anumandal ke liye alag Local Board bane hue the. District Board pehle chhah sarkari tatha atharah gair-sarkari sadasyaon ka hota tha, jinme barah nirvachit the tatha ek nirvachit gair-sarkari adhyaksh hota tha; lekin baad me iski rachna badal kar chalis sadasyaon ki kar di gayi, jinme tees nirvachit the. Local Board me do-tihai sadasya wahi hote the, jo us kshetra ke matdaataon dwaara District Board ke liye chune gaye, tatha baaki sadasya District Board hi nominate karta tha. Is tarah sthaniya swaraj ki vyavastha me nirvachit sadasyaon ka hissa dheere-dheere badhta gaya. Exam point: Jile ka rechit District Board chalis sadasyaon ka tha, jinme tees nirvachit the; pehle yah chhah sarkari tatha atharah gair-sarkari sadasyaon ka hua karta tha.

qe: The District Board was responsible for the maintenance of roads, bridges and roadside rest-houses, and had the general superintendence of which schools?
qh: जिला परिषद सड़कों, पुलों तथा सड़क-किनारे बने विश्रामगृहों के रख-रखाव के लिए उत्तरदायी थी, और किन विद्यालयों की सामान्य देखरेख उसके पास थी?
e: Jile me nagarpalika kshetron ke bahar sthaniya kaam District Board tatha anumandal-stariya Local Boards dekhte the. District Board ke zimme sadkon, pulon tatha sadak-kinare bane aaram-gharon ki marammat tatha dekhabhal thi, tatha uske paas prathmik yaani primary tatha madhya yaani middle vidyalayon ki samanya dekhrekh bhi thi. Iske alawa District Board ko pounds tatha sarkari ghata yaani public ferries ke prabandh ka bhi kaam diya gaya tha. High school tatha college jaisi unchi shiksha ke sansthan aksar government, mission ya niji prayason se chalte the, isliye unka prabandh District Board ke haath me nahi tha. Isi tarah sthaniya nikay gaon-tak ki buniyadi suvidhaon tatha shiksha ke vistar me badhte-badhte shaamil hote gaye. Exam point: District Board sadak, pul tatha sadak-kinare ke vishram-grihon ke saath-prathmik tatha madhya vidyalayon ki samanya dekhrekh karti thi; pounds tatha sarkari ghata ka prabandh bhi usi ke paas tha.

qe: At Dinapore the officer who acted as the small cause court judge was also which other officer?
qh: दीनापुर में जो अधिकारी लघुवाद न्यायालय का न्यायाधीश था, वह और कौन-सा अधिकारी भी था?
e: Jile me civil adalat tatha criminal adalat, dono ka apna alag dhancha tha. Civil yaani dewani muqadamaun ke liye jile me district judge, Bankipore me teen subordinate judges tatha teen munsif, Barh tatha Bihar me munsif, tatha Dinapore me ek small cause court judge tha. Dinapore ka yah small cause court judge apne doosre pad se subdivisional magistrate bhi tha, yaani wahi adhikari jo anumandal ka prashasnik tatha criminal kaam dekhta tha, chhote dewani muqadamaun ka nirnay bhi karta tha. Small cause court aisi adalat hoti hai, jisme kam mulya ke dewani muqadamaun ki sunwai jaldi tatha saral tarike se hoti hai. Isi tarah ek hi adhikari ke paas prashasanik tatha nyayik, dono tarah ke kaam hone se chhote sthalon par kharch tatha adhikariyon ki kami dono door hoti thi. Exam point: Dinapore me small cause court judge ka kaam subdivisional magistrate hi dekhta tha, jabki jile me district judge, teen subordinate judges tatha Barh-Bihar ke munsif civil muqadamaun dekhte the.

qe: In the civil courts of the district, at which places besides Bankipore were munsifs posted?
qh: जिले की दीवानी अदालतों में बांकीपुर के अलावा और किन स्थानों पर मुंसिफ तैनात थे?
e: Jile me dewani yaani civil adalat ka dhancha aisa tha ki Bankipore, jahan district judge baitha karta tha, wahan teen subordinate judges tatha teen munsif the. Munsif yaani aisa nyayadhikari, jo kam mulya ke dewani muqadamaun ki sunwai karta hai tatha chhote sthalon par hi tainat hota hai. Bankipore ke alawa jile me munsif keval Barh tatha Bihar me the, jabki Dinapore me small cause court ka kaam subdivisional magistrate dekhta tha tatha uske liye alag munsif nahi tha. Criminal adalat ka kaam district tatha sessions judge, district magistrate, additional district magistrate tatha stipendiary aur honorary magistrates dekhte the. Isi tarah nyay-vyavastha me mukhya shahar tatha anumandal-stariya sthalon par alag-alag darje ki adalaten banayi gayi thin. Exam point: Dewani adalat me munsif Bankipore ke alawa keval Barh tatha Bihar me tainat the; Dinapore me small cause court ka bhaar subdivisional magistrate par tha.

qe: Land revenue, excise and stamps were three of the main heads of revenue of the district; which was the fourth?
qh: भू-राजस्व, आबकारी तथा स्टाम्प जिले की आय के तीन मुख्य शीर्ष थे; चौथा शीर्ष कौन-सा था?
e: Jile ki aay ke mukhya shirs yaani heads the - bhumi-rajasva, abkari yaani excise, stamps tatha income-tax. Bhumi-rajasva parganon tatha thanon ke hisab se vasool hota tha tatha isi par jile ke prashasan ka bada kharch chalta tha. Abkari ki aay mul roop se deshi sharab ki bikri tatha ganja, bhang jaise nasha-padarthon ki duty tatha license fees se aati thi. Stamps ki aay do tarah ki thi - court-fee stamps, jo adalaton me lagne wale shulk ke roop me lagte the, tatha non-judicial stamps, jo zameen ki kharid-farokht tatha anya samjhauton par lagte the. Chautha shir income-tax tha, jo 1905-6 ke 79,152 rupaye se badh kar 1929 me ek lakh chalis hazaar char sau pandrah rupaye ho gaya tha. Exam point: Jile ki aay ke mukhya shirs bhumi-rajasva, abkari, stamps tatha income-tax the; kiraya-tatha-anulom ke is tarah ke vibhajan se mukhya shirs ka saaf pata chalta hai.

qe: Which municipality of the district, the most important of them all, was established in 1864?
qh: जिले की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण नगरपालिका कौन-सी थी, जो 1864 में स्थापित की गई?
e: Jile me paanch nagarpalikayein thi - Patna, Barh, Bihar, Dinapore tatha Khagaul - tatha inke alawa nayi rajdhani ke kshetra ke liye Patna Administration Committee kaam karti thi. In sab me sabse mahatvapurna nagarpalika Patna City ki thi, jo 1864 me sthapit ki gayi. Iske municipal kshetra me Patna City proper tatha uske upnagar shamil the, jo Bankipore tak phaile hue the; ilaake me 27,600 ratepayers rehte the. Nagarpalika ke paas aay ka achha sadhan tha, lekin kshetra bhi utna hi bada tha, isliye poore kshetra me drainage tatha paani ki supply ke liye dhan ki kami mehnsoos hoti thi. Baaki nagarpalikayein Barh, Bihar, Dinapore tatha Khagaul thi, jo apne chhote karyakshetra tatha kam aay ke saath alag-alag saal me sthapit hui thi. Exam point: jile ki sabse mahatvapurna nagarpalika Patna City 1864 me bani thi, jiske kshetra me Patna City proper tatha Bankipore tak ke upnagar shamil the.

qe: In Patna, as in other districts, cesses levied under which Act formed the principal source of income of the District Board?
qh: पटना में भी, अन्य जिलों की तरह, किस अधिनियम के अंतर्गत उगाहे गए उपकर (सेस) जिला परिषद की आय का मुख्य साधन थे?
e: Nagarpalika kshetron ke bahar jile ke sthaniya kaam District Board dekhti thi, jo poore jile par adhikar rakhti thi tatha jiske antargat har anumandal ke liye alag Local Board bane hue the. Patna jile me, anya jilon ki tarah, Cess Act ke antargat ugahe gaye cess yaani upkar hi District Board ki aay ka mukhya sadhan the. Cess ek aisa kar hai, jo zameen ki aay par tay anupat me lagaya jata tha tatha jisse sthaniya sadke, school tatha safai jaise kaam chalaye jate the. Is kar ka bojh pratyek vyakti par lagbhag chah aana se thoda zyada padta tha, yaani per head incidence six annas se kuch zyada thi. Iske alawa Board ko Local rates, pashu-bandhon, school fees, railway tatha ferry ke toll tatha Government ki grants se bhi aay hoti thi. Exam point: District Board ki aay ka mukhya sadhan Cess Act ke antargat lagne wala cess tha, jiska prati vyakti bojh chah aana se thoda zyada tha; iske alawa Local rates, pashu-bandh, school fees tatha toll se bhi aay hoti thi.

qe: The municipal board of Patna City consisted of forty members; how many of them were elected?
qh: पटना सिटी के नगरपालिका बोर्ड में चालीस सदस्य थे; इनमें से कितने निर्वाचित थे?
e: Patna City nagarpalika jile ki sabse badi nagarpalika thi, jiska gathan 1864 me hua tha. Iske municipal board me chalis sadasya the, jinme se battis nirvachit yaani elected the tatha shesh sadasya anya madhyam se aate the. Aise board me nirvachit sadasyaon ka bada hissa hona dikhata hai ki nagar ke ratepayers yaani kar-dene wale nivasi nagarpalika ke prabandh me seedha bhaag lete the. Isi tarah Patna City me safai, roshni, paani ki supply, sadke tatha aspatal jaise kaam nagarpalika ke zime the, tatha unke liye dhan rates tatha taxes, pashu-bandhon tatha grants se jutaya jata tha. Barh tatha Bihar ki nagarpalikaon me bhi nirvachit sadasyaon ka anupat aisa hi bada tha. Exam point: Patna City nagarpalika ke chalis sadasyaon me se battis nirvachit the; nirvachit sadasyaon ka bada anupat nagar-prabandh me ratepayers ki bhaagidari dikhata hai.

qe: In 1921-22 the largest head of expenditure of the District Board, Rs 4,43,688, was which one?
qh: 1921-22 में जिला परिषद का सबसे बड़ा खर्च-शीर्ष 4,43,688 रुपये का किस पर था?
e: District Board ki jimmedari kshetra ke sadke, pul tatha unke kinare bane aaram-grihon ki marammat tatha dekhabhal ki thi, isliye uska sabse bada kharch civil works yaani nirman-karyon par hota tha. 1921-22 me Board ka kul kharch Rs 7,64,934 tha, jisme sabse badi rakam Rs 4,43,688 civil works yaani sadkon tatha anya nirman-karyon par gayi. Iske baad shiksha par Rs 1,41,981 tatha chikitsa-karyon par Rs 1,00,562 kharch hue; prabandh yaani administration par sirf Rs 57,600, pashu-bandh par Rs 1,507 tatha pension par Rs 6,211 kharch hue. Aise aankde dikhate hain ki gramin kshetra me aavagaman tatha vyapar ke liye sadke banana sabse badi zaroorat thi, isliye Board ka dhan sabse zyada wahin lagta tha. Exam point: 1921-22 me District Board ka sabse bada kharch civil works yaani sadkon tatha nirman-karyon par Rs 4,43,688 hua, jiske baad shiksha par Rs 1,41,981 tatha chikitsa par Rs 1,00,562 kharch hue.

qe: What was the principal source of income of the Patna City municipality, besides a latrine fee?
qh: शौचालय शुल्क के अलावा पटना सिटी नगरपालिका की आय का मुख्य साधन क्या था?
oe: A tax on carts entering the city
A tax on the sale of cattle
A tax on shops in the main bazaar
A tax on the annual value of holdings
oh: शहर में आने वाली गाड़ियों पर कर
मुख्य बाजार की दुकानों पर कर
मिल्कियत के वार्षिक मूल्य पर लगने वाला कर
e: Patna City nagarpalika ki aay ka mukhya sadhan ghar-milkiyat ke saalana mulya yaani annual value par lagne wala kar tha, jiske saath ek latrine fee yaani shauchalay shulk bhi liya jata tha. Annual value ka arth hai kisi sampatti se ek saal me milne wali anumanit aay, jispar nagarpalika tay dar se kar lagati hai. Iske alawa nagarpalika ko pashu-bandhon yaani cattle-pounds, bazaar tatha hackney carriages se bhi thodi aay hoti thi, tatha Government tatha Local Funds se grants bhi milti thi. Nagarpalika ke bade kshetra me ghani aabadi thi, isliye safai yaani conservancy par sabse zyada kharch hota tha; 1921-22 me yah kharch Rs 1,35,442 tak pahuncha. Aise kar-dhanche se pata chalta hai ki nagarpalika ki aay ka bada hissa nagar ki sampatti par lagne wale karon se hi aati thi. Exam point: Patna City nagarpalika ki aay ka mukhya sadhan milkiyat ke saalana mulya par lagne wala kar tatha latrine fee thi; conservancy iska sabse bada kharch-mad tha.

qe: The expenditure of the District Board on education rose from Rs 3,675 in 1917-18 to how much in 1921-22?
qh: जिला परिषद का शिक्षा पर खर्च 1917-18 के 3,675 रुपये से बढ़कर 1921-22 में कितना हो गया?
e: District Board ke paas prathmik tatha madhya vidyalayon ki samanya dekhrekh thi, isliye shiksha uska ek mahatvapurna kharch-shirsh tha. 1917-18 me Board ne shiksha par keval Rs 3,675 kharch kiye the; uske baad yah rakam tezi se badhi tatha 1921-22 me Rs 1,41,981 ho gayi. Yah vriddhi dikhati hai ki pratham vishwa-yuddh ke baad ke saalon me sthaniya nikayon dwara chalaye jaane wale prathmik tatha madhya vidyalayon ki sankhya tatha kharch, dono badhe. Isi daur me chikitsa-karyon par kharch Rs 1,00,562 tatha sadkon tatha nirman-karyon par Rs 4,43,688 ho gaya tha, yaani shiksha ke saath-saath doosre lok-hit ke kaam bhi bade paimane par chal rahe the. Exam point: District Board ka shiksha par kharch 1917-18 ke Rs 3,675 se badh kar 1921-22 me Rs 1,41,981 ho gaya, jo sthaniya shiksha ke vistar ko darshata hai.

qe: Which town of the district, with a municipal board of ten members of whom eight were elected, was constituted a municipality in 1870?
qh: जिले का कौन-सा नगर 1870 में नगरपालिका बना, जिसके बोर्ड में दस सदस्य थे और उनमें से आठ निर्वाचित थे?
e: Barh nagar ko 1870 me nagarpalika banaya gaya. Iske municipal board me das sadasya the, jinme se aath nirvachit yaani elected the. Municipal kshetra ka area lagbhag 2.87 square mile tha tatha wahan 1,940 ratepayers the; ratepayer aise vyakti ko kehte the, jo nagarpalika ko rates tatha taxes deta tha. Barh nagarpalika ki aay rates tatha taxes, pashu-bandhon, bazaron tatha Government aur Local Funds ki grants se aati thi, tatha kharch me administration, roshni, safai, aspatal tatha sadke shamil the. Jile ki anya nagarpalikaon se tulna karne par Barh ek chhote kshetra wali nagarpalika thi, lekin uske board me bhi nirvachit sadasyaon ka hissa zyada tha. Isi tarah unnisvin sadi ke madhya me jile ke vibhinn nagar ek-ek kar ke nagarpalika vyavastha ke daayre me aa gaye. Exam point: Barh 1870 me nagarpalika bana tatha uske das sadasyaon me se aath nirvachit the; ilaake ka kshetra lagbhag 2.87 square mile tha tatha wahan 1,940 ratepayers the.

qe: In 1921-22 the District Board spent Rs 1,00,562 on which head?
qh: 1921-22 में जिला परिषद ने 1,00,562 रुपये किस शीर्ष पर खर्च किए?
e: District Board ke kharch ke mukhya shirsh the - administration yaani prabandh, education yaani shiksha, medical charges yaani chikitsa, veterinary yaani pashu-chikitsa, pensions yaani pension tatha civil works yaani nirman-kary. 1921-22 me Board ne chikitsa-karyon par Rs 1,00,562 kharch kiye, jo us saal ka doosra sabse bada kharch-shirsh tha; shiksha par Rs 1,41,981 tatha sadkon tatha nirman-karyon par Rs 4,43,688 kharch hue. Iske alava pashu-chikitsa par Rs 10,827 tatha pension par Rs 6,211 kharch hue, jabki prabandh par sirf Rs 57,600. Aise kharch se pata chalta hai ki District Board sirf sadke tatha shiksha tak seemit nahi thi, balki gaon ke logon ke swasthya tatha pashuon ki dekhbhal jaise kaamon me bhi dhan lagati thi. Exam point: 1921-22 me District Board ne chikitsa yaani medical charges par Rs 1,00,562 kharch kiye, jabki shiksha par Rs 1,41,981 tatha pashu-chikitsa par Rs 10,827 kharch hue.

qe: Bihar was constituted a municipality in which year, with a municipal board of twenty commissioners of whom sixteen were elected?
qh: बिहार को किस वर्ष नगरपालिका बनाया गया, जिसके नगरपालिका बोर्ड में बीस कमिश्नर थे और उनमें से सोलह निर्वाचित थे?
e: Bihar kshetra ko 1869 me nagarpalika banaya gaya, aur iske municipal board me bees commissioners the, jinme se solah nirvachit yaani elected the. Municipal limits ke andar ka area aath square mile tha tatha wahan 7,600 ratepayers the. Bihar subdivision ka yah nagar apne bade bazaar, anaaj tatha tilhan ke vyapar tatha Nalanda, Rajgir tatha Bihar Sharif jaise dharmik tatha aitihasik sthalon ki nazdiki ke liye prasiddh tha. Nagarpalika ke kharch ke mukhya shirsh administration yaani prabandh, roshni, safai, aspatal tatha sadke the; isi tarah jile ke nagar sath-sath nagarpalika vyavastha ke daayre me aate gaye. Dinapore Nizamat bhi 1869 me hi nagarpalika bana tha, lekin uska kshetra paanch square mile ka tatha ratepayers 4,878 the. Exam point: Bihar 1869 me nagarpalika bana, jiske bees commissioners me se solah nirvachit the; kshetra aath square mile tatha ratepayers 7,600 the.

qe: To the Local Boards, working in subordination to the District Board, was delegated the administration of sums allotted for which purposes?
qh: जिला परिषद के अधीन काम करने वाले स्थानीय बोर्डों को किन कामों के लिए आवंटित राशि के प्रबंध का काम सौंपा गया था?
oe: Village roads, local sanitation, cattle pounds and dispensaries
Collection of land revenue and cess
oh: गाँव की सड़कें, स्थानीय स्वच्छता, पशु-बाँध तथा दवाखाने
e: District Board ke antargat pratyek anumandal ke liye alag Local Boards banaye gaye the, jo Board ke adheen kaam karte the. In Local Boards ko un rakamon ke prabandh ka kaam saunpa gaya tha, jo gaon ki sadkon ke nirman tatha marammat ke liye aavantit hoti thin; iske alava sthaniya safai yaani local sanitation, sthaniya pashu-bandh yaani cattle pounds tatha sthaniya dawakhanon yaani dispensaries ki dekhrekh bhi inke haath me thi. Isi tarah jile ke bade nagar nagarpalikaon ke prabandh me the, jabki gaon tatha chhote kshetra Local Boards tatha District Board ke prabandh me aa gaye the. Aisi vyavastha me sthaniya logon ko apne kshetra ke mool kaamon ki jaankari hoti thi, lekin dhan ki kami tatha karmachariyon ki thodi sankhya ke karan kaam dheere chalta tha. Exam point: Local Boards ko gaon ki sadkon ke nirman-marammat, sthaniya safai, sthaniya pashu-bandhon tatha dawakhanon ke liye aavantit rakamon ka prabandh saunpa gaya tha.

qe: How many municipalities were there in the Patna district, besides the Patna Administration Committee which looked after the new capital?
qh: नई राजधानी की देखरेख करने वाली पटना प्रशासन समिति के अलावा पटना जिले में कितनी नगरपालिकाएँ थीं?
e: Patna jile me paanch nagarpalikayein thi - Patna, Barh, Bihar, Dinapore tatha Khagaul. Inke alawa nayi rajdhani ke kshetra ki nagariya-sevaon ke liye Patna Administration Committee bhi kaam karti thi, jo Act I of 1915 ke antargat namit ki gayi thi tatha jisme nau sadasya the. Nagarpalikaon ka gathan alag-alag saal me hua tha - Patna City 1864 me, Bihar tatha Dinapore Nizamat 1869 me, Barh 1870 me tatha Khagaul 1 July 1907 ko. Har nagarpalika ke paas apna kshetra, apne ratepayers tatha apna municipal board tha, jo administration, roshni, safai, aspatal tatha sadkon jaise kaamon ka prabandh dekhta tha. Isi tarah jile ke nagariya prashasan me nagarpalikayein tatha nayi rajdhani ke liye bani Committee, dono saath-saath kaam kar rahi thi. Exam point: Patna jile me paanch nagarpalikayein thi - Patna, Barh, Bihar, Dinapore tatha Khagaul; inke alava nayi rajdhani ke liye Patna Administration Committee kaam karti thi.

qe: The Patna City municipality extended its limits over Patna City proper and its suburbs up to and including which place?
qh: पटना सिटी नगरपालिका का क्षेत्र पटना सिटी तथा उसके उपनगरों पर फैला हुआ था, जो किस स्थान तक फैले हुए थे?
e: Patna City nagarpalika 1864 me bani thi tatha yah jile ki sabse mahatvapurna nagarpalika thi. Iski municipal limits me Patna City proper tatha uske upnagar shamil the, jo Bankipore tak phaile hue the; is tarah purane shahar tatha Bankipore ka kshetra ek hi nagarpalika ke prabandh me aa gaya. Is kshetra me 27,600 ratepayers the tatha municipal board me chalis sadasya the, jinme se battis nirvachit the. Nagarpalika ne apne kshetra ke pashchim bhaag me paani ki achhi supply ki vyavastha ki thi, lekin pure kshetra me drainage tatha paani ki supply jaise kaam dhan ki kami ke karan adhoore rah jate the. Bankipore jile ke mukhya karyalayon ka sthal tha, isliye uska is nagarpalika me shamil hona is kshetra ke mahatva ko darshata hai. Exam point: Patna City nagarpalika ke kshetra me Patna City proper tatha Bankipore tak ke upnagar shamil the; is kshetra me 27,600 ratepayers the tatha board ke 40 sadasyaon me se 32 nirvachit the.

qe: Which smaller administrative units were created in Bihar after 1947, in addition to a new district and more subdivisions, to have more intimate contact with the people?
qh: लोगों से अधिक निकट संपर्क के लिए 1947 के बाद बिहार में एक नया जिला तथा कुछ और अनुमंडल बनाने के अलावा किन छोटी प्रशासनिक इकाइयों का सृजन किया गया?
e: 1947 me Bihar sarkar ne zilon tatha anumandalon ke punargathan ki samasya ki jaanch ke liye ek Administrative Reorganization Officer niyukta kiya. Iske baad sarkar ne ek naya zila banaya tatha kuchh aur anumandal bhi banaye; iske saath-saath anchal naam ki chhoti prashasanik ikaiyan bhi banayi gayin. Anchal yaani aisa kshetra, jisme kai gaon shamil hote hain tatha jahan ka adhikari logon ki chhoti-chhoti samasyayen sthal par hi nipata sakta hai. Inka uddeshya yah tha ki prashasan aam logon ke aur nazdik aa jaye tatha chhote jhagde tatha kaam sthal par hi nipat jayen. Isi tarah ke prayason se gaon tatha anchal star par rajkiya yojanaon ka kaam aage badhane me asaani hui tatha logon ka prashasan se seedha sampark bana raha. Exam point: Zilon tatha anumandalon ke saath-saath Bihar me anchal naam ki chhoti prashasanik ikaiyan banayi gayin, jisse prashasan ka logon se seedha sampark badhe.

qe: On their accession to power in 1947, the Congress Government of Bihar took which step forward in six of their advanced districts?
qh: 1947 में सत्ता में आने पर बिहार की कांग्रेस सरकार ने अपने छह विकसित जिलों में कौन-सा आगे का कदम उठाया?
oe: Separating the judiciary from the executive
Setting up village panchayats with elected judges
Making education free in those districts
oh: न्यायपालिका को कार्यपालिका से अलग करना
जिला मजिस्ट्रेट व्यवस्था को समाप्त करना
निर्वाचित न्यायाधीशों वाली ग्राम पंचायतें बनाना
उन जिलों में शिक्षा निःशुल्क करना
e: Bharat ki azadi ke samay tatha uske baad Bihar me ek purani bahas chalti rahi ki nyay tatha prashasan, donon ka kaam alag-alag adhikariyon ko diya jaye. 1947 me Bharat ke swatantra hone par Congress sarkar ne Bihar me apne chhah vikshit zilon me nyaypalika yaani judiciary ko karyapalika yaani executive se alag karne ki or ek kadam uthaya. Iska arth yah tha ki jahan pehle District Magistrate prashasanik kaam ke saath-saath nyay ka kaam bhi dekhta tha, wahan aage nyay ka kaam alag nyayadhikariyon ke haath me jane laga. Lok-mat tatha lok-hit ki bhavna ke saath-saath sarkar ne kaam ki tezi tatha kushalta ko bhi dhyaan me rakha. Lekin yah tay hua ki District Officer ki mahatvapurna bhoomika kam nahi hogi, khaaskar shaanti-vyavastha tatha vikas-yojanaon ke kaam me. Exam point: 1947 me Bihar ki Congress sarkar ne apne chhah vikshit zilon me nyaypalika ko karyapalika se alag kiya, jisse nyay ka kaam alag nyayadhikariyon ke paas gaya.

qe: Which Law Member of the Government of India recorded in 1870 that within their own limits the District Officers are the Government?
qh: भारत सरकार के किस लॉ मेंबर ने 1870 में लिखा था कि अपनी सीमाओं के भीतर जिला अधिकारी ही सरकार हैं?
e: Bihar me tatha poore Bharat me jile ka prashasan District Officer yaani District Magistrate ke haath me hota tha, jiske paas police, rajasva tatha anya vikas-vibhagon ki bhi zimedari thi. 1870 me India ki sarkar ke Law Member James Stephen ne ek minute yaani tippan likha, jisme unhonne kaha ki apni-apni seema ke andar tatha apne zile ki aabadi ke maamle me District Officer hi sarkar hai tatha unhe aisa hi bane rahna chahiye. Yah vichar dikhata hai ki unnisvin sadi me jila-star ka adhikari prashasan ka sabse mahatvapurna stambh maana jata tha. Isi parampara ka asar azadi ke baad bhi raha, kyunki District Officer ko yojanaon ke kaam tatha shaanti-vyavastha, donon ki zimedari di gayi tatha 1870 ki is baat ko baad me bhi uddhrit kiya jata raha. Exam point: Law Member James Stephen ne 1870 ke minute me likha tha ki apni seemaon ke andar District Officer hi sarkar hai; isi vichar ne jila-prashasan ki mahatvapurna bhoomika ko darshaya.
